ops.parking: 150 spaces (standard cars) on the premises, available for entry 24 hours. Regular rate: 8:00-24:00 is 400 yen per 30 minutes, 0:00-8:00 is 200 yen per 30 minutes (tax included). Valet parking is 2,000 yen per use for restaurant, banquet and similar use.
ops.waitingRooms: The medium banquet hall "Kiri" can be used as a sub-venue or waiting room for large events.
ops.catering: Dishes finished by the chefs of the Japanese restaurant "Suiren" and the Chinese restaurant "Hoshigaoka" are also prepared in the banquet halls.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the Japanese restaurant "Suiren", the Chinese restaurant "Hoshigaoka" and the all-day dining restaurant "ORIGAMI".
